title: Median-of-R(k)/S_unit(k) singular-series fit (2C2) — AGREEMENT
context: E60/E61 unweighted mean over 20 fixed k-bins diverged from 2C2 with N (1.470 -> 1.498). E62b replaces the mean with the median of R(k)/S_unit(k), which is immune to the erratic multiples-of-6 bins (R(6), R(12) inflated by primes congruent to ±1 mod 6) and needs no variance model. Same N=1e6, same nulls, same gates. E62a (E(k)-weighted pooled) is recorded separately at 1.609 — it amplifies the noisy bins because the geometric E(k) under-predicts even-k counts ~2x.
rel_half: no 1/2 in gen/score; median fit 1.395/1.451 (unweighted mean 1.470/1.487); Δ +0.075; D 1.258/1.321
verdict: AGREEMENT — 2C2 disc=1.395 hold=1.451 in 1.32032±0.15 at N=1e6 with the median-of-R(k)/S_unit(k) estimator (unweighted mean was 1.470/1.487, improved 0.075); G1 D=1.258 vs nulls 0.053; G2 stable.
